content:
After spending 7 months with Aeren IT Solutions P Ltd. as a Legal Associate, I am writing this post with mixed feelings.
I joined the organisation with the intention of contributing sincerely, learning, and growing professionally. During my tenure, I had the opportunity to work, learn, and gain valuable experience, for which I remain grateful.
However, the way my exit is being handled has been disappointing.
My resignation was accepted, and I received a relieving/release confirmation email from HR. However, on 21st July, I subsequently received a separate email regarding my termination — sent after the relieving confirmation had already been issued. This conflicting communication has created confusion regarding my actual employment status, and my Full & Final (F&F) settlement, including pending salary and dues, has still not been released.
I am attaching both communications for transparency, as I believe the sequence of events speaks for itself. I leave it to those reading this to draw their own conclusions, but I do believe this raises a serious concern about the fairness and transparency of the process followed.
As a professional, I believe that separation should be handled with the same transparency and dignity with which an employee is expected to perform their responsibilities.
I am sharing this publicly not to create conflict, but to seek a fair, transparent, and professional resolution. I sincerely hope the concerned management/HR team will look into the matter and ensure that my legitimate pending dues are cleared at the earliest, along with a clear clarification regarding the conflicting communications.
I value the experience I gained during my time with the organisation and would genuinely prefer to close this chapter on a positive and professional note.
I hope this post reaches the right people and that the matter can be resolved amicably and promptly.
